purpose: Collect paid event registrations with attendee details and a simple payment flow.

fields.label: Ticket Type
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible label; ticket names include price in form settings.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible label with min/max capacity guidance.

fields.label: Accessibility or Dietary Notes
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible optional label; do not force sensitive disclosure.

conditional_logic.rule: Payment feed runs only for valid ticket selection, quantity and consent.

confirmations.name: Registration payment result
confirmations.message: Thanks. Your registration is only confirmed once payment is successful; check your email for the next step.

notifications.name: Event payment admin notification
notifications.message: Send attendee and ticket details to event owner after approved payment-notification timing is confirmed.

feeds.name: Stripe event payment
feeds.condition: Run only when ticket, quantity and consent are valid.

spam_settings.turnstile: only if add-on and keys are confirmed

accessibility_settings.label_guidance: No placeholder-only fields; Total is visible before submission.

data_retention_notes: Paid event entries include attendee and payment metadata. Review retention, refund/cancellation policy, receipt data, and export handoff before launch. Consent record must be retained according to approved policy.
required_addons: Stripe Add-On or approved payment gateway add-on
risks: Capacity, refund policy, successful-payment definition, gateway mode, SSL, and event owner handoff require explicit approval before production.
